lines.en: Hi, I am his grandma. Are you his friend?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요, 저는 이 아이의 할머니예요. 이 아이 친구예요?

lines.en: Yes, I am his school friend. Nice to meet you.
lines.ko: 네, 저는 학교 친구예요. 만나서 반가워요.

lines.en: Nice to meet you, too. He is my grandson.
lines.ko: 저도 반가워요. 이 아이는 제 손주예요.

lines.en: I know him. We play together at school.
lines.ko: 그를 알아요. 우리는 학교에서 같이 놀아요.

lines.en: Did you walk here together this morning?
Yes, we walked here together this morning.
She is my daughter. She will cook dinner for us.
lines.ko: 저 사람은 제 딸이에요. 우리에게 저녁을 해 줄 거예요.

lines.en: Thank you. Can I help her?
Of course. Please wash your hands first.
Okay. They look clean now, Grandma.
Excuse me, who is that man over there?
He is my husband. He walks every morning.
And who is she beside him?
lines.ko: 그리고 그 옆에 있는 여자분은 누구예요?

lines.en: She is our daughter. They walk together.
I saw them here yesterday, too.
Yes, they come here every day. Do you know us?
lines.ko: 네, 매일 여기 와요. 우리를 아세요?

lines.en: I know you. You live next to me.
Oh, yes! You gave us apples last week.
lines.ko: 아, 맞아요! 지난주에 우리에게 사과를 주셨죠.

lines.en: I will bring more apples tomorrow.
Thank you. Please come and meet him.
